quantitative_conclusions: First seed only. Best step1000/stop1100; best AbsRel0.088101985315, final0.088163122831 (+0.069394%). Only one validation point after raw best; last significant early-stop anchor was100, smaller later raw gains did not reset patience.

Against actual L577 seed320112 best parent: best AbsRel -0.000374180, scene95%CI[-0.000777112,0.000094206] includes zero; RMSE and boundary-band AbsRel improve, boundary F1 worsens (-0.010824758,CI[-0.015187866,-0.006773477]). Final parent comparison only F1 has an excluding-zero degradation.

S577 versus S500 same seed: only boundary F1 deteriorates with excluding-zero CI at both checkpoints; other four metrics are inconclusive. J577 final F1 comparison benefits from J577 seed320112 late collapse, not from improvement over the actual Lbest parent.

Stage stable_step0 reflects inherited parent quality, not zero total training cost. Own training440.903603s + parent1253.442815s =1694.346418s; whole3800 attempts/3799 successful updates. No S-stage AMP skips or failures.

Final versus best: RMSE,delta1,F1 deterioration has excluding-zero scene CI; AbsRel and band changes remain uncertain. 90/218 AbsRel improve and128 worsen; F1 54 improve152 worsen12 tie. Finite nonconstant shelf predictions; no zero-output explanation.

visual_observations.plots: Four actual plots show near-parent validation plateau despite small raw-best changes; training loss fluctuates about0.0415-0.0428. One postbest point cannot establish long-term stability. Larger-sample comparisons remain mixed.
visual_observations.0005_parent: Almost unchanged geometry; AbsRel0.0678/0.0664/0.0666, F1.364/.340/.338 for Lbest/Sbest/Sfinal. Small table cyan matches lost and right-chair yellow fragments persist; whiteboard missed.
visual_observations.0598_parent: Depth slightly worse (.0552/.0564/.0563); F1.493/.400/.382. Right-table cyan edge largely disappears; thin legs remain missed.
visual_observations.1440_parent: Small depth improvement (.1078/.1065/.1071) but F1.527/.493/.487. Central chair-post false yellow fragments increase and cyan matches fall; counter geometry unchanged.
visual_observations.0226_parent: Depth slightly improves (.1436/.1425/.1415), F1.507/.483/.470; right-body/column and sofa cyan matches fragment, furniture still missed.
visual_observations.0246_parent: Little visible change; depth.1537/.1520/.1524, F1.496/.493/.491. Wrong ceiling and missing shelf edges persist with slight foreground match loss.
visual_observations.0080_parent: Depth improves (.0621/.0595/.0601), F1.641/.541/.460 drops through best to final; central/lower vertical cyan post matches progressively disappear while top cap remains.
visual_observations.500_to577_0005: AbsRel worsens .0623→.0664 while F1 improves .326→.340 (still below B0.369); short left-back-table cyan segment recovered; whiteboard missed both.
visual_observations.500_to577_0598: Both depth.0533→.0564 and F1.434→.400 worsen; remaining right-table cyan matches lost.
visual_observations.500_to577_1440: Depth.0893→.1065 worsens; F1.494→.493 near-equal. Central false post edge broadens/shifts, no structural recovery.
visual_observations.500_to577_0226: Depth.1656→.1425 improves, F1.492→.483 worsens with right-body cyan loss; both depth outputs much better than B0.5841.
visual_observations.500_to577_0246: Depth.1772→.1520 improves but remains worse than B0.1129; F1.515→.493 decreases. Fewer foreground matches and fewer false shelf-top segments; incorrect ceiling remains.
visual_observations.500_to577_0080: Depth.0612→.0595 and F1.456→.541 improve; longer lower central cyan post and some top-cap matches recovered. Fine structures still missing.

interpretation: S577 first seed mainly changes local boundaries at near-parent depth accuracy. Preserve mixed gains and losses; do not declare overall improvement or three-seed result. Complete all seeds before aggregate interpretation.
reviewer: Assistant directly viewed four plots,twelve Lbest-parent/Sbest/Sfinal panels and twelve adjacent-count best panels including B0. Default checkpoint panels were not separately viewed;S endpoints were inspected in parent panels.
scope: 218 validation images/62 scenes;predeclared fixed IDs5/598/1440/226/246/80;no test access.
